assets.name: REV Living E vector master
assets.theme_rules: Use Calm Teal theme variants. Halo is REV-specific and must remain restrained.
assets.source_basis: Founder-approved Living E direction and existing inline SVG/CSS implementation

assets.name: Primary Revision wordmark
assets.theme_rules: Light treatment uses Graphite Ink #132026 with Primary Teal #2BB6A3 for the Living E. Dark treatment uses white with Primary Teal. Monochrome variants use Graphite Ink or white throughout. Clear space is 2x where x is one teal E-bar height; minimum full-wordmark width is 160px digital / 35mm print.
assets.source_basis: Founder-supplied outlined SVG masters received 20 August 2026; 1600x400 working size with transparent background and no embedded font or raster dependency.

assets.name: Revision app icon
assets.theme_rules: Canonical 1024x1024 master uses full-bleed Deep Teal Ink #0F2F36 with the Living E centred in a 760x760 identity frame. No baked outer corner radius. Essential bars/core stay within the central 66% safe region; faint outer halo may clip under platform masks. Favicon omits the halo at 16/32px.
assets.source_basis: Founder-directed identity usage rules, 21 August 2026, derived from approved Living E geometry without changing the mark.

assets.name: REV web motion implementation
assets.theme_rules: Motion must correspond to genuine REV state and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
assets.source_basis: Current learner implementation; timing drift against Brand System v0.9 is documented in docs/technical/Brand System Production Readiness.md.

assets.name: Editable social template masters
assets.theme_rules: Use the approved 1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 canvases after identity masters are stable.

assets.name: Editable video graphics masters
assets.theme_rules: Opening, title, lower-third, caption and end-card masters must use the approved Calm Teal / Manrope / Living E grammar.

assets.name: Manrope typeface
assets.theme_rules: Primary Revision typeface; use approved role hierarchy and system-sans fallback where font loading is unavailable. Current production choice is remote loading from Google Fonts; no font binaries are stored in the brand asset package.
assets.source_basis: Founder-approved Brand System v0.9, current learner runtime in app/index.html, and provenance record assets/brand/manrope-source-and-license.md.
